# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 41 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_041_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 41

**1** Jesus said: "Those who have something will be given more. Those who have nothing will lose even the little they do have."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Those who have something" — general; the "in hand" is implicit
- "Lose even the little they do have" — the emphasis on the minimal that is lost
